subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: While orienting, the skill shall check the idea against merged capability and prior refusals (non-goal and waiting-room rows of merged PRDs; out-of-scope rulings in prior records) and shall surface every overlap with its source and reasoning.
rationale: duplicate and re-litigated ideas are the cheapest sessions to end early
fit_criterion: on fixtures seeded with a covered idea and a previously-refused idea, the overlap is surfaced with the governing row cited, before any framing is offered
